name: Complex — mixed actions
description: A deliberately COMPLEX, state-independent flow that exercises the full action vocabulary and BOTH execution paths (native run_steps + per-step Maestro) in one run: screenshot, waits, scroll both directions, swipe, coordinate double-tap & long-press, an optional conditional tap, negative assertions, wait-until-gone, hide-keyboard, and back. Targets iOS Settings so it runs on any booted simulator without a custom build. Every step is designed to pass regardless of which Settings screen is showing.

steps.label: Dismiss a popup only if it appears
Confirm an error banner is NOT present
Confirm no loading spinner text lingers
